visualReview.notes: Inspected 11 current portable views including the retained 1024×640 summary: the irregular mapped envelope and open medrese court,rows of small grey domes,three-domed porch,windowed central drum and dome,one pale minaret with balcony and grey cone,and domed fountain canopy are present. Courtyard arcades have shallow stone reveals,backing walls and wood-framed opaque panels; the missing interior-facing low wall was corrected. The detail camera now shows the arcade without the fountain blocking its center. Fine lattice,calligraphy,historic tile artwork,street furniture and furnishings are omitted.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 current shared-material/geographic-flat views including the placement overlay. Six existing 256² graphs provide coursed/raw limestone,standing-seam metal,plain wood,ceramic tile and bronze;seven merged roles include local opaque glazing. Metric UVs and linear tints,no embedded images or unique atlas. Shared graphs are read once and model geometry is disposed on eviction. Two exact notched masks preserve the mapped courtyard hole and all 125 surrounding buildings. Courtyard ground and its paving treatment remain host content;the flat overlay checks pose/replacement,the retained standard DEM fixture checks approximate contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected 27 current medium-fi views covering Economy/High,noon/late light,street/block/skyline,silhouette,six details,four matched LODs and four transitions. The court,dome rows,tall central dome,single minaret and fountain canopy persist. Skyline uses simple pointed roof proxies and fewer facets,omits small panes/frames/panels and seats its coarse footing below the sampled minimum. District restores drum/hall glazing and gallery panels;street restores more dome facets,columns and frames;closeup restores further arch/dome points. Whole views show the complete structure;some detail views intentionally crop the minaret tip. Context houses are synthetic. Physical-device and full-city timing remain pending.

The tall hall and its corner domes simplify the unseen roof transitions;no claim of a measured roof plan is made. Current finishes,precise retaining levels,stairs,thresholds,courtyard paving,lattice,historic tilework,interiors,engineering and complete current condition remain unverified. The two 2008 pictures establish exterior vocabulary only.
